text:
Priya: Heads-up 10min sync. Post-launch metrics look good overall but we've got a handful of small regressions customers reported. We need to pick 3 small, low-risk fixes to push in the next two sprints. No major infra.

Liam: I'm in. My suggestions: (A) transient 429 handling on the API edge, (B) streaming UI shows spinners too long when chunking stalls, (C) reduce embed hallucination for 2 customer flows by reverting a single postprocess tweak.

Rosa: +1. For C, can we limit the revert to a subset of customers first? We should avoid a wide rollback.

Priya: Yes. We can do a per-org model pin for the embed change. Route e.g. 10% of affected org traffic to the previous postprocess and compare similarity/precision.

Ethan: Quick estimates from eng: A = 6-8h (server retry + idempotency checks), B = 2-4h (ux tweak + copy + smoke), C = 2d (ML + infra gating for canary).

Liam: Also propose a hygiene ticket: add a "rollback plan" checkbox to all launch-critical PRs. Launch felt messy because rollbacks weren't explicit.

Rosa: I can own the grooming session for that ticket. I'll run a 45m async rubric review tomorrow and share notes. Rubric: customer impact, rollback complexity, data retention risk, infra touch.

Priya: Good. For acceptance criteria, let's be explicit so QA can sign off quickly. Example for A: "After rollout, <1% clients see 429s over 24h and automatic retries succeed without increasing p99 >20%."

DevBot: [notice] Canary job created for API retry patch. Canary window = 3h, auto-rollback on alert p99+error-rate threshold.

Ethan: Ops guardrail: if p95 latency increases >25% during canary, abort. We'll also add a synthetic test hitting retry path every 30s.

Rosa: UX detail for B: replace indeterminate spinner with streaming chunk indicator + an inline "try again" link after 7s stall. Less anxiety for users.

Liam: For C, ML: we need a short evaluation set (50 queries) per org to compare A-B metrics before and after revert. Can do automated A/B for 48h.

Priya: Who picks up A? I can triage and ship if nobody objects.

Ethan: I'll do the canary orchestration and the synthetic tests.

Rosa: I'll post the grooming Loom and create the rollback-plan checklist in the backlog ticket.

Liam: I'll handle the embed eval harness and the per-org selection list. Priya: can you dump the top affected org IDs into the ticket?

Priya: Will do. Recap: owners assigned and ACs written. Ship targets: A (1 day), B (0.5 day), C (canary-ready in 2 days). If anyone thinks timelines are off, call it out within 4 hours. :calendar:

DevBot: [deploy-notice] Patch uploaded to staging for API retry.

Priya: Thanks team. I'll create sprint slices and tag owners now. Short and targeted ":thumbsup:"
